MS-001.goal: Implement a trustworthy token-attempt receipt and ledger contract without activating optimization policy

assertions.description: Versioned token-attempt receipt distinguishes estimated, render and host-reported usage states and preserves unknown/unavailable.
The ledger is append-only and replaying attempt_id plus receipt_id is idempotent without double counting.
Missing, partial, dirty, oversized and out-of-order receipts have deterministic results.
Schema and persistence reject prompt, response, source body, credentials, private absolute paths and unknown payload fields.
Existing runs tokens behavior and aggregation remain backward compatible.
Focused queries filter by task/run/status/host/model without scanning or returning receipt bodies.
Tracked _shared, zh and en Management API projections remain semantically identical.
Implementation is additive, zero-dependency and does not create a new Task/Run state owner.
Changed tracked files have no whitespace errors.
Diff contains no automatic compaction, routing, model downgrade, transcript crawling or policy activation.

MS-002.goal: Collect real host receipts in shadow mode without private transcript access

assertions.description: Two distinct governed Host adapters emit schema-valid receipts.
assertions.expected: real receipts from at least two Hosts

assertions.description: Adapter receipts contain only allowlisted identifiers, counts, statuses, digests and reason codes.
Unsupported usage fields remain unknown or unavailable and are never inferred from private storage.
Retries, process restarts and duplicate delivery do not double count receipts.
All adapters remain shadow-only and cannot alter context, model, fan-out or stop behavior.

MS-003.goal: Produce a reproducible seven-day baseline and quality/cost evaluation

assertions.description: At least two Hosts each have 100 non-test receipts across seven consecutive days.
Task success, missing-context failure and reread/tool retry metrics are reported alongside tokens.
Measured savings exclude unknown usage and clearly label estimated cost projections.
Baseline cohort, policy revision, host/model dimensions and query window can be reproduced.
Any recommendation to activate P-002, P-003 or P-004 is a new resource-bound Decision, not an automatic action.
